name: Crypto World's Fair Hackathon by Colosseum
description:
An online hackathon bringing together builders and founders across all crypto ecosystems to launch breakout startups.

## Crypto World's Fair

Crypto World's Fair is an open competition of the ideas, technologies, and communities shaping the blockchain ecosystem. Builders and founders exhibit the products and innovations driving the next wave of crypto startups that bring the world's markets onchain. Submissions are due October 12, 2026.

## Awards and opportunities

Teams compete for $840,000 in prizes and $2.5 million in seed funding, including a $30,000 grand prize and $300,000 shared across the next 20 best projects. All hackathon winners are interviewed and considered for Colosseum's accelerator program with pre-seed funding, founder network access and mentorship.

## Tracks

Ecosystem tracks with dedicated prize pools include Solana, Ethereum, Hyperliquid, Base, Tempo, Arbitrum, Zcash and Robinhood Chain, each judged with builders, investors and operators from those ecosystems.

## Judges

The Colosseum team reviews all submissions, joined by track judges including Clay Robbins, Matty Taylor and Nate Levine alongside builders and investors from Phantom, Base, Arcium, MetaDAO and Ellipsis Labs.

## Accelerator

All hackathon winners are interviewed and considered for the Colosseum accelerator program with pre-seed funding, founder network access and mentorship, including a residency collaborating directly with the Colosseum team.

## Livestream workshops

All workshops stream live on Discord, including the kickoff with the Colosseum founders. Participants can watch live, ask questions and follow the program through the event.

name: India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026
description:
India Blockchain & AI Tour 2026 is the fifth edition of Octaloop's multi-city event series for blockchain and AI developers, founders, investors and enterprise teams. The tour runs across ten Indian cities from September 26 to November 22.

Metamorphosis in Hyderabad is the tour's two-day flagship event on September 26-27. Its announced program includes investor roundtables and a Founder Demo Day.

The remaining stops are Bengaluru on October 17, Chennai on October 18, Mumbai on October 31, Pune on November 1, Goa on November 7, Delhi on November 14, Jaipur on November 15, Lucknow on November 21 and Chandigarh on November 22. The organizer lists the city events from 10 AM to 5 PM.

Each stop has its own event and registration page. Use the [official tour schedule](https://indiablockchaintour.com/2026-nodes) to select a city and book its tickets; Hyderabad registration is handled through the [Metamorphosis website](https://metamorphosisconf.com/).

name: The/Garage Cohort 2 - Housing
description:
the/Garage Cohort 2 | Housing

Hospedagem para builders de fora de São Paulo

O the/Garage é presencial, e sabemos que nem todo builder de fora de São Paulo tem condições de bancar hospedagem por duas semanas. Por isso, a Superteam Brasil oferece apoio com hospedagem durante o programa.

Leia com atenção antes de solicitar:

 As vagas são muito limitadas. Bem menos vagas do que o número de participantes do programa.

O apoio de hospedagem é destinado a quem atende os dois critérios ao mesmo tempo:

Necessidade real: builders que não têm condições de pagar a própria hospedagem em São Paulo. Se você pode arcar com sua estadia, deixe a vaga para quem precisa;

Nível do builder: entre os que precisam, priorizaremos os melhores builders e os times com maior potencial, seguindo os mesmos critérios de seleção do programa.

Solicitar hospedagem aqui não garante a vaga. As solicitações serão analisadas junto com a aplicação do coworking, e os aprovados receberão confirmação por e-mail.

Datas de entrada e saída: seja preciso

Cada cama liberada abre espaço para outro builder entrar. Por isso, precisamos saber exatamente quando você chega e quando sai, e pedimos que marque as datas conforme sua necessidade real, não "por garantia".

Check-in mais cedo: 27 de setembro (véspera do início do programa);

Check-out mais tarde: 11 de outubro (dia seguinte ao encerramento);

O programa acontece de 28 de setembro a 10 de outubro de 2026.

Se seus planos mudarem e você for sair antes, avise o time o quanto antes: sua vaga pode ser a chance de outro builder participar.

Importante

A solicitação de hospedagem é separada da inscrição no coworking. Você precisa aplicar nos dois;

Vagas sujeitas à disponibilidade e à análise do time da Superteam Brasil;

Detalhes do local e regras de convivência serão enviados aos aprovados.

name: Bitchill s04
description:
network, learn & leisue - bitcoin retreat comes back with season 4!

It's not a conference. It's not a business trip.It's a one-week tropical reset with Bitcoiners from around the world - diving, tennis, open mics, barbecues, workshops, and sunset beers... all in the most Bitcoin-friendly jurisdiction on Earth - Próspera on Roatan.

 Coliving with fellow Bitcoiners in one of the world's most exciting experiments - Próspera special economic zone.

 Activities to fill your days: diving, sailing, yoga, sports, BBQ nights, pool parties.

 Community stage: open mic, lightning talks and debates about the future of Bitcoin and freedom.

 Island exploration - hidden beaches, local food spots, and off-the-map adventures.

 A soft landing into Próspera - meet residents, explore business opportunities, and find out what's up there.

 Freedom to chill - no rigid agenda. The week has a rhythm, but plenty of space for serendipity.

 curious about Próspera digital nomads & entrepreneurs creators, builders & free spirits who go with the flow

 party-tourists complainers and freeloaders s****ners and control freaks people allergic to new ideas

Every Bitchill is different, but every is full of activities, networking, tourism, education and chill. Agenda of the upcoming retreat is shaped at published at the Bitchill Plan page.Find below, what type of activities are usually arranged during Bitchill:

 Wellness: breathwork workshops, meditation sessions, cold plunge, yoga, longevity clinic visit

From the US: Direct flights from Houston, Miami, Atlanta, Dallas.

From Europe: Via US hubs or San Salvador (San Pedro Sula or Tegucigalpa).

To Plan B (San Salvador): Commercial flights through SAP ($350) or direct charter to Roatán arranged (700,000 sat)

Come for as long as you want! Monthly options are also available.Feel free to find accomodation on your own.

Bitchill is not your typical Bitcoin conference or networking trip. It's a week or longer Bitcoin retreat in the Caribbean, designed for builders, creators, and free spirits who want to recharge while connecting with like-minded people. Instead of endless panels in hotel ballrooms, you'll spend your days diving in crystal-clear waters, joining open mic sessions, playing tennis or golf, and sharing barbecues and beers at sunset.

At the same time, Bitchill gives you a soft landing into Próspera, the world's most Bitcoin-friendly jurisdiction, where you'll meet residents, explore business opportunities, and see firsthand how life on Roatán blends tropical ease with frontier innovation.

Tickets are priced in Bitcoin (sats) and give you access to the full Bitchill experience.The base ticket (200,000 sats) covers:

- Selected group activities - BBQ nights, pool parties, yoga sessions, open mic talks, and intro experiences

- Full logistical support - we help arrange travel, pickups, and make sure your stay is smooth

- Community integration - meet residents, explore Próspera, and get introduced to the Bitcoin District

Accommodation is not included in the base ticket, so you can choose the housing that best fits your vibe and budget. Prices are for one full week:

- Studio: 90,000 sats/night - private, spacious, ideal for couples

 Staying longer? Many participants extend their visit and turn Bitchill into a month-long immersion in Caribbean life and Próspera's Bitcoin-first community. We can help arrange that too.

- Daily meals (except special group events like welcome brunch or BBQ nights)

- Optional extras such as premium tours or diving certifications

Bitchill is non-profit - every satoshi collected (and often a few more) goes directly into covering accommodation, activities, and event costs.

Próspera is a special economic zone on Roatán, Honduras, built as a hub for innovation, entrepreneurship, and freedom. It's one of the first places on Earth where Bitcoin is recognized as legal tender, and where you can set up a business, pay taxes, and live fully on a Bitcoin standard.

During Bitchill, you'll meet residents of the zone, tour the facilities, and learn about opportunities ranging from Caribbean real estate to Bitcoin-friendly company incorporation. Many attendees come away seeing not just a retreat, but a glimpse into what a freer future could look like.

Roatán itself is a tropical paradise: white sand beaches, world-class diving, and a relaxed Caribbean vibe. Unlike mainland Honduras, it's safe and designed for international visitors, with a growing expat and Bitcoin community.

Bitchill isn't just a vacation - it's your entry point into the Bitcoin District in Próspera. This is where Bitcoiners are building a neighborhood and an ecosystem powered by freedom and Bitcoin. You'll meet locals, see opportunities in residency, business, and real estate, and experience firsthand what it means to live free on Bitcoin in a pioneering jurisdiction.

January is one of the best months to be on Roatán. It sits right after the rainy season and just as the island shifts into its clearest, breeziest, most comfortable period.

- Very little rain - you might get a short shower, but it's quick and refreshing

- Excellent diving conditions - January typically brings clear water and calmer seas

In short: perfect tropical winter escape. Warm, sunny, and reliable - without the unpredictable downpours of late fall.

If rain happens, it's usually a brief shower that clears the air and opens up beautiful sunsets. All outdoor activities (beach fires, boat trips, tennis, snorkeling) run normally this time of year.

Meals are self-organized, giving you the freedom to explore the island's food scene. Roatán has everything from local Honduran street food like baleadas to fresh seafood grills and high-end Caribbean restaurants. Many places in Próspera accept Bitcoin payments via Lightning, while USD cash is widely accepted elsewhere. Group meals are part of the program, too.

Roatán (RTB) has direct international flights from Houston, Miami, Atlanta, Denver, Belize and Guatemala City. Plus great domestic connection in San Pedro Sula.

We'll be there with pickups, transfers, and local guidance so you never feel lost.

Yes. Most participants are digital nomads or entrepreneurs, so reliable internet is a must. Coliving spaces have solid WiFi, and we also provide SIM backups and Starlink.

There are coworking sessions at the Bitcoin Center in Próspera, but you're always free to work from your villa terrace, the café, or anywhere else.

Roatán is a Caribbean island that welcomes thousands of international tourists every year. It's much safer than mainland Honduras, with a strong expat community and infrastructure designed for visitors.

That said, it's still a developing country: you'll want to be mindful like anywhere else in Latin America. We'll guide you on the do's and don'ts, and you'll feel comfortable moving around.

Both. Bitchill is about freedom, Bitcoin, and community, but it's also about sunbeds, cocktails, and beach barbecues. You'll leave with a tan, new friends, and fresh ideas for building a freer future.

The week is designed to reset your mind and spirit while also giving you exposure to one of the most exciting experiments in governance and Bitcoin adoption anywhere in the world.

name: A Global Living Lab: Light DAO's Next International Gathering
description:
Members of Light DAO's leadership recently participated in Edge Esmeralda and came away feeling it was one of the most impressive, inspiring and transformative business gatherings we had ever experienced - because it was not a conference, retreat or summit.

It was a Society Incubator - an extraordinary integration of worlds that are rarely found in one place.

In a single day, you might:

 Begin the morning with a tea ceremony, breathwork or yoga

 Move into a talk with brilliant researchers, founders and investors on frontier science and emerging technology

 Spend a few hours building software, testing experimental health wearables, collaborating in a maker space, or creating in a media lab

 Head into nature, join a wellness session, or get absorbed in a discussion on the latest in AI agents, fintech or longevity

 Continue the conversations over dinner late into the evening - or end the night with music, ecstatic dance or a calming sound bath

 For families, dedicated programs for kids and teens, starting at age 4, offer opportunities to play, learn, create and build within their own community

 Alongside all of this are deep conversations about consciousness, philosophy, society and human flourishing

It felt like stepping into a living laboratory for the future - a temporary village designed to explore and experiment with how we might live, work, learn, build and thrive differently.

It offered a glimpse of what the world could look like when innovation, human flourishing and community are developed together.

## This is Edge City.

Edge Cities are 3-4 week Living Labs and Society Incubators - international popup villages where frontier technology, science, entrepreneurship, consciousness, culture, art, well-being and community are not separate tracks, but part of one shared environment.

Edge Cities have already taken place in Patagonia, Chiang Mai, Cape Town and Esmeralda, two hours north of San Francisco.

Edge Esmeralda - June 2026

- 850 residents from 60+ countries
- Nearly 300 stayed for the full month
- 800+ sessions and experiments
- Families came with 48 kids

What made it so extraordinary was being surrounded by brilliant, conscious innovators genuinely committed to advancing humanity - with enough time together for real relationships, collaborations and radical ideas to develop.

[www.EdgeEsmeralda.com](https://www.EdgeEsmeralda.com)

That experience convinced us that Edge City offers something unusually valuable for the Light DAO community.

So this October, we're taking our community to the next Edge City.

## The Next Edge City: Goa, India

October 11 - November 1, 2026

We're taking our community to Edge India in Goa - a three-week Living Lab and Society Incubator with hundreds of participants, approximately 65% coming from outside India.

Light DAO will have our own RESIDENCY within the larger Edge India community, so our members can take part in the full Edge experience while also connecting more intimately with our own community.

## A Living Lab Created by Its Community

One of the things that makes Edge Cities especially unique and powerful is its unconference-style format. Much of the experience is created by the participants themselves - through the talks, demos, experiments and working groups they lead around the ideas and projects they care most about.

Light DAO will also host more intimate gatherings within our own Residency, led by our guests.

Once registered, Light DAO Owner Members are welcome to contact us with ideas you might like to lead or contribute to. We can't guarantee a place in either the Light DAO or Edge programming, but we'd love to hear what you are most excited to share.

That participatory spirit is part of what makes Edge a true Living Lab: the community does not simply attend the experience - it helps create it.

## A Special Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency

We're delighted to be partnering with SingularityNET for a 3-week Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency at Edge India. This is the first collaboration of its kind we've run with the SingularityNET team.

Everyone racing toward AGI is making the same bet: that a bigger model gets there. SingularityNET is not.

Led by Dr. Ben Goertzel, who launched the term and concept of Artificial General Intelligence, the team scales Beneficial General Intelligence on Hyperon, a cognitive architecture with two decades of research behind it. It holds knowledge, goals and decisions in a form you can inspect, shows its reasoning, and runs under explicit permissions - which is what makes it deployable inside real institutions.

The residency puts you in the room with the people building it. Talks, working sessions and open build time for developers, founders, researchers, investors, and anyone serious about AGI, ASI and beneficial technology.

Bring what you are already building. Leave with something concrete: a technical integration, a partnership, an investment conversation, or a prototype you put together on-site at Edge India.

## Why Join the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency?

In addition to the full Edge India experience, our Residency gives you a more intimate community to connect, collaborate and build with throughout your stay, including:

 Light DAO + SingularityNET talks, working sessions and open build time

 More intimate conversations and collaborations within our residency group, particularly with SingularityNET's leadership and tech team.

 Light DAO-organized meals, including opportunities for participants to lead topic conversations

 Optional group outings and shared experiences

 Opportunities for Light DAO Owner Members to propose topics they may want to lead or contribute to

 A shared home base at our beachfront resort

Think of our residency as your home community within the larger Edge India Living Lab.

## What Makes Edge Cities a Unique Living Lab + Society Incubator

Hear Edge Cities co-founder Timour Kosters talk about the multidisciplinary, multigenerational and global vision behind Edge Cities - including its unconference format and experiments.

He shares how the experience stretches people's sense of what is possible, helps them embody that expansion, and activates new collaborations and directions. In 1-3 weeks, many participants accelerate results that might otherwise have taken months or longer.

The Edge experience is designed around focused work, collaboration, wellness, community and time to enjoy Goa.

Your Edge Pass includes the full Edge India experience - programming, coworking, wellness, community gatherings and more.

## Pricing

Edge India Pass

Prices increase weekly

- 2-3 weeks (same price): $1,500-$2,000
- 1 week: $750-$1,000
- Day pass: $150-$200
- Indian citizens: 50% discount

 Our Beachfront 4-Star Resort

[www.RivaResorts.com](https://www.RivaResorts.com)

Our Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency will be based at Edge India's central hotel.

- Private room + breakfast: $100 per room/night
- Lunch + dinner: approximately $30 - 50/day
  Your choice - at the resort or anywhere in Goa

Yes - you get your own private room. At $100/night including breakfast, this is an exceptional value for a beachfront 4-star resort.

If you're coming as a couple, it is the same $100/night including breakfast for 2!

Roommates also the same $100/night!

Lunches, dinners and excursions are paid individually, giving you the flexibility to join our residency plans, other Edge activities, or your own plans in Goa.

## Joining the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency

Edge Cities are curated communities with an application and approval process.

Light DAO Owner Members and friends we already know:
Please RSVP here on Luma. You will automatically be approved to Edge India through our Residency.

If you are new to us:
Please RSVP here on Luma and complete the registration questions thoughtfully. Thank you.

Once approved through the Light DAO + SingularityNET Residency, you will not need to complete a separate Edge City application.

Ready to Join?
Choose one of the two ticket options above.
Once approved, we'll send you:

- the direct link to purchase your Edge ticket at the current lowest price
- the resort reservation link

Come experience our collaboration between Edge Cities, SingularityNET and Light DAO - where frontier ideas, deep community and real opportunities to build and collaborate come together in one Living Lab.

You may leave with a partnership, a prototype, a new collaborator, or an entirely new direction you had not imagined before joining this unique Society Incubator.

name: Digital Assets: From Regulatory Frameworks to Asset Allocation EY x Belem Capital x Swiss Risk Association x BSA (EPFL)
description:
Belem Capital, EY, the Blockchain Student Association (BSA), and the Swiss Risk Association are pleased to invite you to a private morning event dedicated to asset allocators, private wealth managers, family offices, and professional investors.

As digital assets become an increasingly established part of the financial landscape, two questions are becoming central for investment professionals: how should the risks and regulatory considerations associated with this asset class be addressed, and how can digital assets be incorporated into a broader portfolio construction and asset allocation framework?

This event will bring together asset managers, risk specialists, regulatory experts, and allocators with a clear objective: to provide practical perspectives on the regulatory, risk-management, and investment frameworks that matter most to professional investors, while confronting these frameworks with the experience of market participants.

Through three keynotes and two panel discussions, we will explore the evolving regulatory environment in Switzerland and Europe, risk management in digital assets, the development of tokenisation and stablecoins, and the role of digital assets within professional investment portfolios.

name: Navigating Career Transitions in the Age of AI: Defining Your Professional Narrative
description:
As technology rapidly reshapes industries, job roles, and required skill sets, professionals are increasingly being asked to adapt before the path forward is fully clear. Whether navigating a career transition, responding to AI-driven disruption, repositioning yourself in a competitive job market, or hiring talent for emerging roles, success depends on more than technical expertise - it requires the ability to tell a compelling professional story.

This highly interactive session uses Interactive Business Theater, featuring professional actors portraying realistic workplace and career conversations, to explore how individuals can define and communicate their unique value in a changing world of work. Through facilitated discussion, audience participation, and practical frameworks, participants will learn how to build a professional narrative that aligns their experiences, strengths, and aspirations with evolving employer needs.

Learning Objectives:

- Identify and articulate your unique value proposition in a rapidly evolving labor market
- Translate past experiences and transferable skills into a compelling professional narrative
- Position yourself competitively amid AI, automation, and shifting workforce demands
- Navigate career development conversations with greater confidence, clarity, and adaptability

Facilitator: Rahul Kay, MBA, MPH

Rahul Kay helps organizations develop leaders who can navigate uncertainty, drive performance, and build stronger workplace cultures. As the Director of Client Success, his work focuses on leadership development, organizational effectiveness, and experiential learning. Prior to Ibis, Rahul was the CEO of an employee mental health organization, worked in organizational strategy at McKinsey, and supported change initiatives through the United Nations. He holds an MBA from the MIT Sloan School of Management, and MPH from Tufts Medical, and studied clinical psychology at Cornell.

U-Hackathon runs inside Flow Summit, a two-day summit on the future of finance and the future of community. You get a hall of your own, 24 hours on the clock, mentors on the floor. Get the best out of your allocated time. Then you demo on the stage.

The format: Hack → Mentor→ Present → Judge

 Hack : 2 days hack, 10:00 Thursday to Friday. No filler panels, no keynote before you're allowed to open your laptop. Sleep is a personal choice.

 Mentor : product, engineering and design mentors on the floor the entire time. Make the most out of your allocated slot, plus people walking the room looking mildly concerned about your architecture.

 Present : Qualified Project demo on the stage Friday afternoon.

 Judge : judges pick six finalists on merit. Then the U-Center DAO Community votes live to choose the grand prize.

 Bring your AI squad

Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT, whatever agent stack you've quietly assembled. All fair game, on both tracks. There is no "Did you write this by hand" inquisition. It's 2026. Ship something good. Solving meaningful problem is the way.

Two rules, though:

Your teammates are humans. Up to 3 of them excluding you. Solo builder? You can ask for in event teammate. (Only team leader have to register).

name: DC Privacy Summit
description:
The Third Annual DC Privacy Summit will take place on October 15, 2026, at the National Union Building in Washington, D.C.

The DC Privacy Summit is a unique forum for urgent conversations about converging technological trends. Zero-knowledge proofs and other powerful cryptographic tools are raising novel questions about the law, and about the relationship between the US government and its citizens. Policymakers across the country (and around the world) are rushing to introduce digital identification credentials and age verification mandates. Sophisticated cyberattackers are turning consumer data security into a matter of national security. And the rise of AI is supercharging it all.

We organize this event because the people building these technologies and the people writing the rules governing them too rarely talk directly. If favorable privacy, security, and policy outcomes are to be achieved, this must change. That is our aim.

This year we have refined the format to help maximize the event's impact. We'll kick things off on the night of the 14th with the Cypherpunk Policy Dinner (separate admission required). The main event on the 15th is designed as a pop-up think tank, and will feature focused, invite-only roundtables as well as talks, firesides, and panels in front of an audience of up to 200 people. (For a sense of how this will look and feel, please see videos of the 2025 DC Privacy Summit and April's Stablecoin Privacy Summit.) We'll close out the day with a reception to give our high-signal audience an opportunity to mingle.

Here are some of the key questions we'll address throughout the day:

How can the public and private sectors improve their coordination to achieve better outcomes against cyberattackers like North Korea's Lazarus Group?

Is there a realistic path to privacy-preserving digital identification?

What do privacy-minded policymakers need from technologists working on the frontier of digital privacy and identity? What do technologists need from policymakers?

What are the implications of tools like zero-knowledge proofs beyond blockchains and cryptocurrencies?

What does AI mean for privacy, security, and freedom?

For more information, see dcprivacysummit.org.

name: Maritime Dual-Use Hackathon
description:
The Fincantieri Maritime Dual-Use Hackathon comes to San Francisco, October 16-18.

Following the first edition in Rome, which brought together 70+ participants, including Italian Navy engineers, and produced five working prototypes, the challenge now crosses the Atlantic to the Bay Area's deep-tech ecosystem.

Over 48 hours, engineers, developers, founders, researchers and designers will form teams to build working solutions around real maritime and defense engineering challenges, with access to technical mentors, development hardware and potential opportunities to continue developing the strongest concepts beyond the event.

## Challenge Tracks

1. OT Cybersecurity & Blast Radius Analysis
2. Piping Layout Optimization
3. Software-Defined Vessel

## Build with Real Hardware

Participants will have access to a selection of Qualcomm and Arduino technologies during the hackathon, including Snapdragon-powered laptops, edge AI and robotics development platforms, Arduino prototyping hardware and supporting developer tools.

These tools are intended for hands-on technical development. Participants with experience in areas such as software development, embedded systems, electronics, robotics, edge AI, computer vision or hardware prototyping will be best positioned to take full advantage of them.

Qualcomm and Arduino technologies will be introduced during the opening session so teams can quickly understand the available resources and integrate hardware, edge AI, computer vision, sensors or robotics into their prototypes.

Exact hardware configurations will be shared with participants ahead of the event.

## More Than a 48-Hour Hackathon

The goal is not only to build a prototype, but to identify ideas with the potential to continue developing after the event.

- Work on real Fincantieri challenges with potential relevance to future maritime and defense applications.
- Compete for a Qualcomm-powered laptop awarded to the winning team.
- Develop your concept beyond the hackathon: selected promising prototypes may have the opportunity to continue evolving.
- Access Fincantieri expertise: winning and particularly promising concepts may receive mentoring from Fincantieri's network of experts to help further mature the solution and explore its potential application within Fincantieri.
- Connect with leading technical talent from industry, academia, venture capital and the defense innovation ecosystem.

## Partners & Ecosystem

[The hackathon is powered by Fincantieri](https://www.fincantieri.com/en), [Mind The Bridge](https://mindthebridge.com/)[and Silicon Mountain](https://www.linkedin.com/company/silicon-mtn/posts/?feedView=all).

Qualcomm is the main technology sponsor, supporting participants with hardware, development resources and technology expertise throughout the event.

Additional experts from Fincantieri, academia, industry, venture capital and the defense innovation ecosystem will support teams through mentoring and judging.

## What to Expect

- 48 hours of hands-on building and prototyping
- Real technical challenges provided by Fincantieri
- Access to Qualcomm and Arduino hardware and development resources
- Mentors and domain experts supporting teams throughout the event
- Collaboration with engineers, founders, and researchers
- A Qualcomm-powered laptop prize for the winning team
- Potential follow-on development opportunities for the most promising concepts

No maritime background is required. However, this is a hands-on technical hackathon, and participants should be ready to contribute directly through software development, AI/ML, embedded systems, cybersecurity, robotics, engineering, CAD/optimization, product design or prototyping.

Come with a team or find one at the event.

To help us maintain an accurate headcount, a $20 refundable deposit is required to reserve your spot. The deposit will be fully refunded when you attend the event.

Spots are limited - register early to secure your place.

name: ExecuTorch Hackathon
description:
NOTE: By registering for the Luma, you are submitting an application to participate. We will reach out on a rolling basis to let you know whether you've been accepted. There are a limited number of devices, we can support up to 200 participants.

This event is sponsored by Meta, Qualcomm, GitHub, Open Intelligence Foundation, and the PyTorch Foundation.

Join developers, researchers, and builders for the upcoming ExecuTorch Hackathon on October 17 -18 at [Founder's Inc., officially part of Open Source AI Week 2026](https://opensourceaiweek.com/).

[Hosted in collaboration with Qualcomm](https://www.qualcomm.com/developer), [Meta](https://www.meta.com/), [GitHub](https://github.com/), [the PyTorch Foundation](https://pytorch.org/foundation/), [and Open Intelligence Foundation](https://openintelligence.foundation/), this hands-on event will challenge teams [to build innovative AI experiences powered by ExecuTorch](https://executorch.ai/) - an open-source framework for deploying and running PyTorch models efficiently on edge and on-device hardware.

Participants will work in teams of 3-5 people and select one of three tracks outlined below. Each team will receive a device from their selected track to use during the event. Builders will also get access to GitHub Copilot Pro+ to support their builds.

Compute Track

Build AI applications optimized for the Copilot+ PC powered by Snapdragon® X Elite processors, exploring the potential of powerful, efficient on-device AI computing.

Mobile + XR Track

Create AI-powered experiences for the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra powered by Snapdragon 8 Elite and Samsung Galaxy XR powered by Snapdragon® XR2+ Gen 2 processor, with a focus on mobile intelligence, immersive interaction, and multimodal applications.

IoT Track

Develop intelligent edge and embedded applications using the Arduino® VENTUNO™ Q boards, combining on-device AI with real-time sensing, control, and connected experiences. Choose from an assortment of modulinos and accessories to complete your project (available on a first come, first served basis).

To participate, interested teams must select a track, form a team of 3-5, and submit a project proposal by October 4. Selected teams will be announced by October 7.

Prizes

The top team in each track will receive a prize package for every member of the team: Meta AI glasses and an Arduino® UNO™ Q. Build a standout project, demonstrate the potential of on-device AI, and take home hardware to continue exploring the edge.

GitHub will also award a one-year subscription to Copilot Pro to the winner.

Whether you are an experienced edge AI developer or eager to explore the future of open-source, on-device intelligence, the ExecuTorch Hackathon is an opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and build with the latest hardware and software across compute, mobile, XR, and IoT.

Questions? Join our Discord!
Ask questions about the event, connect with other participants, form a team, receive event announcements, and stay up to date throughout the hackathon.

 Join here: https://discord.gg/A635v4hMSg

Bring your ideas. Build with ExecuTorch. Help shape the future of open-source, on device AI.

About Open Intelligence Foundation

[The Open Intelligence Foundation](https://openintelligence.foundation/) is a community-first nonprofit founded to protect, strengthen, and advance open-source AI, open models, and open science. Supported by a large community of volunteers and organizations, it takes a bottom-up approach to collaboration, working with academia and researchers to support research, development, and education in [open-source AI. The foundation also leads Open Source AI Week](https://opensourceaiweek.com/), a community-run initiative celebrating open-source AI.

About Founders, Inc.
[Founders, Inc.](https://f.inc/) backs early-stage founders in emerging tech with first checks and 55,000 sq. ft. of lab space in San Francisco's Fort Mason. They run year-round programs to help ambitious builders to go from early stage to scalable companies.

Snapdragon and Qualcomm branded products are products of Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. and/or its subsidiaries. Arduino and VENTUNO are trademarks or registered trademarks of Arduino S.r.l.

name: Project Harmonia Frankfurt: Allfunds x Solana Salon
description:
An invite-only series of gatherings across Europe, hosted by Solana and Allfunds, bringing together the people shaping the next chapter of institutional finance onchain.

As recently announced, Solana and Allfunds Blockchain have reached an agreement under which Allfunds Blockchain will be expanding distribution of its tokenised funds to Solana: establishing a direct commercial bridge between traditional fund distribution networks and public, on-chain markets.

From London to Frankfurt, Milan, Madrid, Paris and beyond, we're convening senior leaders across asset management, distribution, capital markets, custody and financial infrastructure.

Through intimate salons and high-signal gatherings, this event will bring together buy-side, sell-side and market infrastructure partners with Allfunds Blockchain as a guest, to explore how tokenised funds can be deployed, what it unlocks for institutional access and liquidity, and where the near-term opportunities are for firms considering on-chain distribution.

Allfunds is a global wealthtech platform connecting fund houses and distributors through technology and infrastructure.

The Solana Foundation is a non-profit organisation based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the decentralisation, growth, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a proof-of-stake blockchain built for mass adoption ◎ Fast, composable, green, and globally distributed.

name: Merkle Science Meet Las Vegas: Enterprise Compliance for Digital Assets
description:
Join Merkle Science at Caeser Palace in Las Vegas during Money20/20 for an afternoon of focused discussion on enterprise compliance for digital assets.

Hosted and sponsored by global law firm Duane Morris, the event is supported by Aleo, a privacy-first blockchain; Stablecon, a conference for the stablecoin ecosystem; nSure.ai, an AI-powered payment fraud prevention platform; Movantis, a cross-border payments infrastructure provider; and Range, a treasury, risk, and compliance platform for programmable money.

This edition of Merkle Science Meet brings together leaders from financial institutions, fintechs, payment providers, and digital asset companies to examine the practical realities behind programmable money.

The program will explore evolving compliance requirements, AI-driven risk management, bank-crypto convergence, and the growing use of stablecoins for cross-border payments. Expect candid conversations grounded in what companies are building today, where regulatory and operational challenges remain, and what the next phase of institutional adoption may look like.

What to expect

Short, substantive sessions led by industry practitioners

Perspectives from payments, banking, fintech, compliance, and digital assets

Practical discussions covering regulation, infrastructure, risk, and real-world implementation

Product demonstrations and opportunities to connect with speakers and attendees

Drinks and networking following the program

Agenda

1:30 PM-1:50 PM | Arrival and networking

Light refreshments and informal networking.

1:50 PM-2:00 PM | Welcome remarks

Opening remarks from Merkle Science leadership.

2:00 PM-2:40 PM | Crypto Payments in the Age of Programmable Money

Stablecoins and tokenized deposits are entering the payments stack alongside card rails, ACH, and wire networks. This panel will examine how payment compliance programs must adapt when settlement becomes near-instant and programmable, how transaction-monitoring tools are evolving to handle blockchain-native flows and on- and off-ramp activity, and how payment companies are navigating the overlap between traditional money-transmission obligations and emerging digital asset requirements.

Panelists:

Adam Leaman, Chief Compliance Officer, zerohash

2:40 PM-2:55 PM | Range demo

2:55 PM-3:35 PM | AI, Risk and the Future of Stablecoin Infrastructure

As stablecoins and digital assets become increasingly integrated into mainstream financial infrastructure, AI is playing a growing role in how institutions manage risk, compliance, and operational complexity.

This session will explore how financial institutions, fintechs, payment providers, and digital asset companies are using AI to strengthen risk management, improve transaction monitoring, and scale compliance across increasingly complex financial flows. Speakers will also discuss the limitations of AI-driven compliance, the continued importance of human oversight, and how institutions are approaching the risks created by AI's growing role in financial infrastructure.

Banks are revisiting their approach to crypto custody, stablecoin issuance, digital asset payments, and lending. This panel brings together perspectives from banking, compliance, and fintech to examine how that convergence is taking shape: what institutions are building or acquiring, how risk frameworks are adapting, and what the shift means for crypto-native companies competing for the same institutional customers.

Stablecoins are increasingly being used to address the cost and speed limitations of cross-border payments and remittances, particularly in corridors underserved by correspondent banking.

name: 金融機構數位資產實務轉型 Presented by TAAS - 年度系列講座 (五) 從 API 到操作流程：金融機構如何串接數位資產基礎設施
description:
【金融機構數位資產實務轉型】系列講座

Practical Transformation of Digital Assets for Financial Institutions Presented by TAAS

系列講座（五）Forum 05｜從 API 到操作流程：金融機構如何串接數位資產基礎設施

About This Forum

當安全架構確立後，金融機構下一步需要面對的是系統與流程的整合：數位資產基礎設施應如何與既有金融系統接軌。

數位資產並非獨立運作，而是需要與核心銀行系統、風控系統、帳務系統與內部流程整合。從 API 串接、交易流程設計、權限控管，到跨部門協作，都是導入過程中的關鍵挑戰。

本場將從實務角度出發，說明金融機構在導入數位資產時，如何設計系統串接與操作流程，並整理導入過程中常見的整合問題與解決方式，協助機構建立可實際運作的架構。

Key Topics

數位資產基礎設施的系統架構

API 串接與核心系統整合

交易流程與操作流程設計

跨部門協作與內部流程整合

What You'll Gain

系統整合與流程設計的基本理解

API 與內部系統串接的關鍵考量

可用於內部導入討論的實務架構

Suggested Audience

銀行（IT / Security / Risk / Digital Banking）

金控與資產管理機構

金融科技與系統整合商

企業 treasury / 財務相關部門

Speakers

Organizer

TAAS
TAAS（Treasury as a Service）致力於構建數位資產時代的企業級財庫管理基礎設施。透過深度整合資產託管（Custody）、穩定幣支付結算（Settlement）、跨境資金流管理（Cross-border）與即時數據審計，我們為全球企業與金融機構提供一套合規、安全且具備高度擴展性的資本運作系統 。 TAAS 不僅是連接傳統金融與區塊鏈網路的戰略中樞 ， 更賦能企業在變動的數位環境中，建立穩健且可持續的數位資產戰略儲備與財務管理能力 。

Partners

BitGo
BitGo 是首屈一指的數位資產解決方案基礎設施供應商，自 2013 年成立以來深受各大機構信賴。提供機構級託管、安全與錢包架構相關專業支援，參與託管、MPC、多重簽名、資產隔離等議題分享，提供金融機構可理解的基礎設施與落地觀點，並支援後續技術與架構層交流。

Capital Layer
Capital Layer 是亞洲機構金融的穩定幣基礎設施層，為銀行、系統整合商與金融機構提供合規穩定幣營運所需的模組化平台。將託管、合規、私鑰管理與結算協調整合於單一層級，讓機構不用重建底層工程，就能合法合規地向企業客戶推出數位資產服務。

敦陽科技
敦陽科技股份有限公司 (Stark Technology, Inc., STI) 是台灣最大的國內系統整合商，我們為超過 2,000 家客戶提供完整的資訊與通訊技術 (ICT) 產品系統整合服務。身為台灣 500 大服務企業之一，我們透過代理和經銷全球頂尖的產品，為各種產業規劃及提供完整的 ICT 解決方案。我們是台灣的公共系統整合商中最穩健且財力最雄厚的公司之一，也是眾人眼中的典範。

紅樓資本
紅樓資本（Red Building Capital）是台灣首家深耕區塊鏈技術與 Web3.0 的風險投資公司，以 Venture Studio 為核心定位，除了佈局 Sui 生態系、DeFi 及鏈上金融等前瞻領域，更深度參與項目的早期構思與國際募資。紅樓不僅提供股權與代幣投資，更整合法律諮詢、營銷策略及全球資源，透過資源協同效應協助團隊從在地走向國際，全方位提升項目的商業價值。

About the Program

隨著台灣數位資產相關專法與監管架構逐步發展，金融機構面對的已不只是新市場機會，而是如何在既有法遵、風控與內控制度下，重新理解數位資產在金融體系中的定位與可行性。

數位資產的影響，已逐步從市場與投資層面，延伸到制度、託管、安全、支付清算、資產儲備、合規監控與金融產品設計等實務層面。對金融機構而言，真正需要面對的問題包括：

專法與制度發展將如何影響金融機構進入數位資產市場的方式

機構應如何在既有法遵、風控與內控制度下承接數位資產

穩定幣是否將改變未來支付與清算模式

託管、安全與資產隔離應採取何種機構級架構

DAT 與資產代幣化是否會成為未來金融機構資產配置與產品設計的一部分

因此，本系列以一年期規劃，透過四大主題、十二場論壇，建立一條從制度理解、基礎設施設計、支付清算應用，到資產儲備與產品延伸的完整路徑，讓金融機構不只理解趨勢，更能在一年內形成實際的評估與導入框架。

Program Purpose

本系列講座的目的包括：

協助台灣金融機構系統性理解數位資產實務轉型的完整架構，從制度、基礎設施到應用層建立整體認知

結合台灣數位資產相關法規與專法發展方向，協助金融機構在既有監管與內控制度下，理解數位資產業務的可行範圍與導入條件

讓參與機構掌握專法、合規、託管、安全、穩定幣、DAT 與資產代幣化等議題的實際導入邏輯，而非僅停留於市場概念

建立金融機構跨部門共同語言，作為策略、法遵、風控、產品與 IT 部門之間的討論基礎

以年度系列講座形式，作為金融機構內部教育訓練與產業知識普及的一環，降低組織導入新型金融基礎設施時的認知落差

提供金融機構從理解、評估到實務規劃的持續交流平台

為後續顧問導入、基礎設施合作、產品設計與商務延伸建立基礎

Program Positioning

本系列論壇並非泛市場型的加密活動，而是專為金融機構設計的年度實務轉型企劃，同時定位為一套結合台灣金融監管脈絡之教育訓練與產業知識普及機制。

整體內容圍繞三條主線展開：

DAT｜數位資產儲備與配置策略
 回應金融機構與企業財務在資產負債表、儲備資產與配置策略上的新需求。

Stablecoin｜支付、清算與資金流轉
 回應穩定幣對跨境支付、清算效率與資金管理所帶來的改變。

Custody｜機構級託管與安全基礎設施
 回應金融機構在導入數位資產時，對託管、安全、合規與操作流程的需求。

Series Structure

本系列共分為四大主題、十二場論壇：

主題一｜制度與專法

聚焦制度位置、專法發展、責任邊界與合規要求，建立進場前判斷框架。

Forum 01｜專法上路前後：金融機構如何理解數位資產的制度位置

Forum 02｜合格託管的角色：金融機構應自建、外包，還是混合架構

Forum 03｜KYC、AML 與鏈上合規：數位資產風控如何落地

主題二｜託管與安全底層

聚焦託管、安全、授權與系統整合，建立機構級安全與操作架構。

Forum 04｜MPC、多重簽名與機構級數位資產安全架構

Forum 05｜從 API 到操作流程：金融機構如何串接數位資產基礎設施

Forum 06｜資產隔離、保險與法律保護：機構級託管的風險結構

主題三｜DAT、RWA 與導入路徑

聚焦資產配置、產品設計與實際導入，讓全年內容收斂為可執行方向。

Forum 07｜DAT：金融機構與企業財務的數位資產儲備策略

Forum 08｜資產代幣化（RWA）與金融產品設計

Forum 09｜從理解到導入：金融機構數位資產轉型的下一步

主題四｜穩定幣、支付與清算實務

聚焦穩定幣如何從概念進入支付、跨境資金流與清算實務。

Forum 10｜穩定幣發行架構：金融機構可以扮演什麼角色

Forum 11｜跨境支付與 24/7 清算：穩定幣如何改變資金流動

Forum 12｜儲備機制、透明度與市場信任：穩定幣如何被金融機構接受

*本頁為系列第四場，屬於 主題二｜託管與安全底層。

name: My First Bitcoin: Education Is Freedom
description:
Join My First Bitcoin at PubKey for an evening exploring how grassroots Bitcoin education is growing into a global movement for freedom, opportunity, and self-sovereignty.

At the heart of the evening is the exclusive premiere of our new documentary, filmed across Indonesia in August 2026. No one has seen the film before.

The documentary follows our journey from Jakarta to Bandung, Surabaya, and finally Bali, capturing the different Bitcoin communities we encountered along the way and the stories of the people building them. We traveled together with Dimas, the leader of Bitcoin Indonesia, meeting local educators, community leaders, and Bitcoiners to understand what adoption looks like on the ground across one of the world's most diverse countries.

Through their stories, the film explores how grassroots, open-source education is helping people better understand money, Bitcoin, and their own financial agency - and how very different local communities are turning that knowledge into action.

Following the screening, My First Bitcoin founder John Dennehy, members of the organization, and special guests will share the story behind My First Bitcoin, how the movement has grown from its roots in El Salvador into a global network of independent educators and communities, and why education sits at the heart of meaningful Bitcoin adoption.

We'll discuss the connection between Bitcoin, education, freedom, and self-sovereignty - and what it takes to build a movement that empowers people to think independently, take greater ownership of their financial lives, and bring that knowledge back to their own communities.

Whether you already know My First Bitcoin, are deeply involved in Bitcoin, or are simply curious about the role education can play in expanding access and understanding, we'd love to have you join us.

Be among the first to see the film. Stay for the conversation. Meet the people helping build the global Bitcoin education movement.

name: UK Tokenisation Summit 2026
description:
## The TokenisationLandscape

Tokenisation is reshaping every sector. From decentralised finance and creator economies to enterprise supply chains and public infrastructure, distributed ledger technology is delivering measurable results today.

## Real-World Assets

From bonds and equities to real estate, tokenisation is enabling fractional ownership, 24/7 settlement, and dramatically lower transaction costs across global markets.

## DeFi & Digital Finance

Decentralised finance protocols are reshaping lending, trading, and payments -- creating open, permissionless financial infrastructure accessible to everyone.

## Supply Chain & Provenance

Blockchain verifies product origin, reduces fraud, and gives consumers transparent, tamper-proof records from source to shelf.

## Digital Identity

Blockchain-backed digital IDs and verifiable credentials are giving individuals control over their data while reducing identity fraud across sectors.

## Creator Economy & IP

Artists, musicians, and creators are using tokenisation to monetise work directly, manage royalties transparently, and build new models of community ownership.

## Public Sector & Infrastructure

From land registries to healthcare records, governments and institutions are adopting tokenisation to improve transparency, reduce costs, and modernise public services.

name: BCNL x VBNL x PwC - CARF & DAC8 Roundtable
description:
The regulatory landscape for digital assets continues to evolve. With CARF and DAC8, crypto businesses and financial institutions face a new set of tax transparency, due diligence, data, and reporting requirements.

Together with PwC Netherlands, BCNL and VBNL are organizing an exclusive and highly interactive session focused entirely on what CARF and DAC8 mean in practice.

Date: 28-10-26
15:30 - 19:00
PwC Netherlands
Limited & curated attendance

From regulation to implementation

The session will be led by PwC's team of operational tax experts, specializing in areas including FATCA/CRS, CESOP and Digital Services Taxes. The team includes a former OECD member who contributed to the development of CARF, complemented by operational tax professionals with more than 10 years of experience in the financial sector.

Rather than focusing solely on the technical regulation, this session is designed to answer the practical questions:

What does CARF/DAC8 actually mean for your organization? What do you need to prepare? Where are the known pitfalls? And what challenges are other organizations already encountering?

The 5 Building Blocks of CARF

During the roundtable, PwC will take participants through five key areas:

1. Entity Management
Determining whether your organization falls within the scope of the regulation.

2. Product Analysis
Identifying which products and services are in scope.

3. Due Diligence
Understanding the requirements, how to implement them, and how they align with existing AML/KYC processes.

4. Reporting
What needs to be reported, where and when, which data points are required, and what this means for your organization and systems.

5. Governance Set-up
Establishing the right policies, procedures, responsibilities, and internal governance.

For each building block, we'll connect the regulatory requirements with real-world implementation, known pitfalls, and challenges PwC is seeing across the market.

An interactive roundtable

This is deliberately a small-scale and interactive session, not a traditional conference.

The core roundtable will last approximately two hours, with plenty of room for discussion, practical cases, and questions from participants. Attendees will also have the opportunity to submit questions and topics in advance, allowing the PwC team to tailor the conversation to the challenges organizations are actually facing.

Following the session, we'll continue with drinks and networking, giving participants the opportunity to exchange experiences and connect with peers.

Who should attend?

The session is particularly relevant for finance, tax, compliance and operational professionals working at:

Crypto exchanges - Brokers - Payment providers & PSPs - E-money institutions - Market makers - Banks & financial institutions - Other organizations active in or expanding into digital assets

Professionals from traditional financial institutions exploring or expanding their crypto activities are also very welcome.

About PwC Netherlands

PwC Netherlands supports crypto businesses in navigating evolving tax transparency and reporting requirements, including CARF, CESOP, DAC7, and relevant domestic obligations. By combining tax, regulatory, and technology capabilities, PwC helps organizations assess their scope and build the data, systems, processes, and governance required for sustainable compliance.

About BCNL Foundation

BCNL Foundation connects and strengthens the Dutch digital asset ecosystem by bringing together companies, financial institutions, policymakers, investors, and industry professionals through events, education, advocacy, and strategic collaboration.

About NVC (VBNL)
NVC is the Dutch CASP Association, formerly known as VBNL Founded in 2014, NVC has a long history advocating for the interests of bitcoin- and crypto companies, promoting self-regulation, coordination with stakeholders such as legislators, regulators and law enforcement, and maintaining the highest standards of reputation an integrity. Members are: Bitvavo, MoonPay, Coinmerce, zerohash, Blockrise, BTC Direct, Bitmymoney, Blox, Fiat Republic, Acheron Trading & Finst.

Capacity is limited and registrations will be curated.

If CARF/DAC8 could impact your organization, this is an opportunity to discuss the implications directly with experts and peers before the requirements become part of day-to-day operations.

name: India Blockchain Week 2026
description:
India Blockchain Week 2026 takes place on 1-2 November at Fairmont Mumbai. Hosted by Hashed Emergent, this is the fourth IBW conference and its first edition in Mumbai after three editions in Bangalore.

The two-day conference is part of the wider India Blockchain Week, which includes independently organized hackathons, workshops, meetups and investor dinners. The side-event listings below link to individual event pages; check each organizer's registration requirements when planning your week.

## Tickets and access

The organizer lists these pass prices as of 29 September 2026, before applicable taxes, including GST:

- **General - ₹1,499:** Access to both conference days, the exhibition area and the IBW Connect app.
- **Priority - ₹3,499:** General benefits plus the Fairmont lunch buffet on both days and Institutional Forum eligibility.
- **VIP - ₹29,999:** Priority benefits plus the Grand Terminus VIP lounge and the pre-conference VIP dinner night.
- **Executive VIP - ₹59,999:** VIP benefits plus one night's stay at Fairmont and dedicated airport transfers.
- **Student - ₹999:** General benefits plus priority access to workshops and hackathon eligibility.

Use the [official ticket page](https://www.indiablockchainweek.com/#tickets) to check current prices and pass availability.

## Speakers

The announced 2026 lineup includes Eli Ben-Sasson (StarkWare), Keone Hon (Monad Foundation), Prabal Banerjee (Avail), Marcin Kazmierczak (RedStone Oracles), Doug Hsu (CMT Digital) and Harshit Tiwari (NEAR Foundation).

The session agenda is still being finalized. The [official speaker directory](https://indiablockchainweek.com/ibw_2026/speakers) lists the current speakers and their roles as further names are announced.

partnerOffer.text: Hashtag Web3 is a community partner of India Blockchain Week 2026. Use code IBW26HASHTAG for 10% off conference passes.

name: IBW Institutional Forum
description:
The IBW Institutional Forum 2026 - India's only invite-only, closed-door room where traditional finance meets blockchain. 1-2 November 2026 at Fairmont Mumbai, hosted by Hashed Emergent.

## Format

One closed-door room for the whole conversation, held under the Chatham House Rule. Participation is limited to selected applicants, with every attendee carefully reviewed to ensure the right mix of expertise. A decade in the making, the forum gathers a curated cross-section of the ecosystem.

## Agenda

Sessions get into conditional disbursements, offline payments, and a programmable rupee moving from pilot to production, carrying the calibre IBW has convened across three editions - from Ethereum, Polygon and Coinbase to the Government of India.

description:
The third Entity Legal Summit - after Devconnect Buenos Aires (2025) and Consensus HK (2026).

One room, one question: what is an onchain entity, legally - and who answers for the AI agents inside it?

Founders, lawyers, protocol designers, and governance architects working the legal frontier of AI agents, DAOs, and autonomous systems. This is a working summit, not a showcase: law as code, agent personhood and ERC-8004, decentralized justice and AI arbitration, borderless entities, liability frameworks, onchain civil records - and this year, India's own frontier: online dispute resolution, digital public infrastructure, and what national registries can learn from open ones.

name: The Institutional Table: Private Dinner on Tokenization, Stablecoins and Security | Mumbai
description:
41 seats. One table. No panel, no pitch deck.

The Institutional Table is a private, invite-only dinner hosted by QuillAudits on the evening IBW closes and the night before Devcon opens. Banks, asset managers, funds, exchanges, tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers, in one room, talking about what it actually takes to put regulated assets on public chains without getting burned.

What we will talk about

Tokenization at scale: what breaks when a fund, bond or real estate structure moves on-chain. ERC-3643, ERC-4626 vaults, NAV oracles, transfer restrictions and the compliance layer around them.

Stablecoins as payment rails: reserve attestations, mint and burn controls, blacklist and freeze functions, and where issuers have been exploited.

The institutional security bar: what a board, a regulator and a counterparty should be able to ask for before capital moves. Audits, formal verification, monitoring, key management, incident response.

What went wrong in 2026: a closed-door walk through the year's institutional-grade incidents, and what each one should have caught earlier.

Format

Seated dinner for 41. Short opening from QuillAudits, then moderated conversation under Chatham House rules. No recording, no press, no slides.

Who is at the table

Heads of digital assets, treasury and product at banks and asset managers. Founders and CxOs of tokenization platforms and stablecoin issuers. Fund partners with RWA and stablecoin exposure. Regulators and policy leads by invitation.

Seats are confirmed personally. Registering here is a request, not a confirmation. Venue in BKC, Mumbai, shared with confirmed guests.

About QuillAudits

8+ years securing Web3. 1,500+ audits, 1M+ lines reviewed. 20+ RWA and tokenization protocols audited including Plume, Lumia, Pharos and Zoth. Full lifecycle security: AI and human audits, formal verification, OpSec, multisig review and monitoring.

name: The Yield Layer of Social Impact
description:
The Yield Layer of Social Impact is a half-day side event at Ethereum Devcon Mumbai, co-hosted by Launchnodes and GSR Foundation. We bring together donors, impact organisations, and the protocols underwriting on-chain yield.

The premise: staking and stablecoin yield can fund global impact at scale, without donors parting with their principal.The day is built as a deliberate arc: what has been built, where the capital comes from, what is getting built on top, and where it goes next. Expect fireside conversations with the protocols underwriting on-chain yield, a keynote from a leading global impact voice, and panels with donors, foundations, and builders.

Tens of billions sit in on-chain stablecoins, alongside millions of ETH staked. Most of the yield is reinvested, idle, or consumed by operating costs. Over the last two years, Launchnodes has built the rails that let any of that yield flow directly to vetted impact organisations, while the principal stays staked and fully withdrawable. Those rails are Lido Impact Staking and Stablecoin for Impact built on Aave.

The infrastructure exists. The question now is how to open these rails to non crypto institutional TVL and convert that capital into measurable impact at scale.

The room is curated: India's largest corporate philanthropy operations alongside on-chain capital, impact organisations already operating on-chain or actively exploring it, and the protocols underwriting it all.

If yield becomes the next layer of philanthropy, this is the room where it starts.----------------------This event is organised by Launchnodes, the Ethereum infrastructure company behind Lido Impact Staking and Stablecoin for Impact. Launchnodes builds the financial rails that let on-chain yield flow directly to vetted impact organisations. Together, these products form Impactstake.com, the platform connecting donor capital with measurable social and environmental outcomes. Launchnodes also builds infrastructure and dApps on Canton Network for traditional financial institutions.

Bitcoin is at the center of politics and regulation - Bitcoin Amsterdam unites leaders to shape a fair, thriving future across Europe.

## An Unprecedented Conference Experience

## Jack Mallers

Strike Jack Mallers is the Founder and CEO of Strike, the global Bitcoin app. Prior to Strike, Jack was one of the first application developers on top of Bitcoin's Lightning Network. Jack has spent the last decade of his life in the Bitcoin space, pioneering efforts in distributed systems infrastructure, architecture, and application development.

## Edward Snowden

Edward Snowden is a privacy advocate and former intelligence contractor whose 2013 disclosures revealed the scope of global government surveillance programs, sparking an international debate on privacy, security, and civil liberties. Since then, he has become a prominent voice on digital privacy, encryption, and the relationship between technology and individual freedom, contributing to discussions on the societal implications of surveillance in the digital age.

## Pierre Rochard

Pierre Rochard has researched and written about Bitcoin since 2013. He co-founded the Satoshi Nakamoto Institute in 2014 to curate the best primary source literature. In addition to developing open-source Bitcoin software, Pierre is an outspoken advocate for Bitcoin's decentralized governance. He co-hosts the Noded Bitcoin Podcast and the Bitcoin for Advisors Podcast. Pierre served as the Bitcoin and Lightning product manager at Kraken for three years before joining Riot as the VP of Research.

## Obi Nwosu

Obi Nwosu is cofounder and CEO of Fedi and a zealous advocate for Bitcoin mass adoption. He previously founded the Bitcoin exchange Coinfloor, and holds board positions at ₿trust and Gridless Compute

## Adam Back

Co-founder and CEO of Blockstream, Dr. Adam Back, invented Hashcash, the proof-of-work algorithm cited by Satoshi Nakamoto in the Bitcoin whitepaper, as the future basis for its mining function. Throughout his two-decade-long vocation as an applied cryptographer and security architect, he has held senior roles with a number of technology companies, including Microsoft, EMC, PI, VMware, and Zero-Knowledge Systems, as well as advised many more companies on cryptography and peer-to-peer finance. Dr. Adam Back holds a computer science Ph.D. in distributed systems from the University of Exeter.

## Elizabeth Stark

Elizabeth Stark is CEO and Founder of Lightning Labs, where she is building a programmable financial layer for the internet with fast, scalable bitcoin transactions.

## Joana Cotar

Independent Member of the German Parliament. Founder of the ""Bitcoin im Bundestag"" initiative. The initiative is committed to raising awareness and educating members of the German Bundestag about Bitcoin. It aims to ensure that political decision-makers are always up to date and can adequately consider the impact of Bitcoin on society.

## Ben Arc

Ben Arc is a developer, educator, and open-source contributor focused on improving Bitcoin's usability through Lightning Network tools and self-custody solutions. He is best known for creating and maintaining projects such as LNbits, which help individuals and businesses build on Bitcoin with accessible, open-source infrastructure. Ben is an active advocate for decentralized technologies, privacy, and expanding practical Bitcoin adoption around the world.

name: Ship Safe: Devcon Mumbai Security Sessions by QuillAudits
description:
Last day of Devcon. Before you head to the closing party, spend one session on the thing that decides whether what you shipped this week survives contact with mainnet.

Ship Safe is QuillAudits' security session for Devcon Mumbai: real exploit teardowns, a practical audit-readiness clinic, and a panel on what actually broke in 2026 and why. Short talks, hard questions, then drinks.

What to expect

Exploit teardowns: we walk through the biggest 2026 incidents line by line. Where the bug was, why the audit missed it, what the fix looked like.

Audit readiness: how to prepare a codebase so an audit finds real issues instead of formatting nits. Scoping, invariants, test coverage, what to freeze before review.

AI vs AI: how attackers are using AI to find bugs faster, and what AI-assisted auditing and formal verification change for teams shipping on tight timelines.

Panel: founders, auditors and researchers on the security debt building up across L2s, RWA and stablecoin rails, and what they would do differently.

Networking and drinks from 6:45 PM.

Who should come

Founders, CTOs and protocol engineers shipping on Ethereum and L2s. Security researchers and auditors. RWA, stablecoin and DeFi teams. Anyone who wants an honest look at how things break.

About QuillAudits

8+ years securing Web3. 1,500+ audits, 1M+ lines reviewed, trusted by teams including StarkWare, Taiko, ZetaChain and Metis. Full lifecycle security: AI and human audits, OpSec, multisig review and monitoring.

Venue in BKC, Mumbai, shared with confirmed attendees. Seats are limited and every registration is reviewed.

Join us for the [London edition of the PR1ME Series, during Solana Breakpoint](https://solana.com/breakpoint) powered by the Onchain Finance Institute (OCF), [Solana Foundation](https://solana.org/), [Lukka](https://lukka.tech/) [and Breezing](https://breezing.io/).

This invite only, community driven gathering brings together leading minds in web3 accounting and finance.

This event is exclusively for finance professionals - CFOs, COOs, Controllers, Heads of Finance, or equivalent. We're unable to accept applications outside these roles.

Important: Only confirmed guests with a QR code will be allowed entry. Please note that walk-ins or unapproved registrations will not be possible.

## About Solana Foundation

[The Solana Foundation](https://solana.org/) is a non-profit organisation based in Zug, Switzerland, dedicated to the decentralisation, growth, and security of the Solana network. Solana is a proof-of-stake blockchain built for mass adoption. Fast, composable, green, and globally distributed.

## About Lukka

[Lukka](https://lukka.tech/) is the institutional data backbone for digital assets, transforming fragmented on-chain and off-chain activity into audit-ready intelligence. Trusted by global financial institutions, asset managers, custodians, exchanges, and regulators, Lukka delivers the trust, truth, and transparency needed to power pricing, valuation, compliance, risk management, accounting, and reporting across digital and tokenized assets.

## About Breezing

[Breezing](https://breezing.io/) is a crypto subledger built specifically for accounting professionals managing digital assets. It connects directly to blockchains, exchanges, and accounting systems like Xero and QuickBooks, eliminating the manual work of exporting CSVs and posting journal entries by hand.

[Used by 200+ businesses including ht.digital](https://ht.digital), BDO, ETH Global, Safe, and Dune.

SOC 2 certified and Swiss-made🇨🇭.

## About Onchain Finance Institute (OCF)

Onchain Finance Institute (OCF) (https://www.onchainfinanceinstitute.com/) is an education and community platform helping finance professionals build real-world onchain finance skills for accounting, treasury, and finance roles.

Join 150+ alumni and 400+ community members from organizations such as Solana Foundation, a16z, Ava Labs, Starknet, and more, upskilling with digital assets and transitioning into the future of onchain finance.

name: North American Blockchain Summit 2026
description:
The era of speculation is over. Blueprints reflects our collective mission to finalize the technical, energetic, and regulatory frameworks that will define North American leadership for decades to come. Attend NABS to get hands-on with the people securing our digital future and deploying the next generation of infrastructure.

NABS is the conference for the leaders architecting the future of digital infrastructure. Focused on the core pillars of strategic infrastructure, capital, partnerships, and global leadership, the Summit convenes C-suite executives, policymakers, and innovators to secure and deploy the next generation of North American legacy.

This is where the industry's blueprints are refined and the partnerships that drive global scale are solidified.Hosted by the Digital Infrastructure Network, the Summit provides an unprecedented look through the lens of a state bringing leadership to the global economy.

This year, NABS is expanding into the full digital infrastructure conversation. Our focus includes data centers and compute, AI, energy and the grid, quantum technologies, Bitcoin and digital assets, and the capital and policy that support all of them.

What ties those areas together is that none can develop in isolation. AI needs compute; compute needs power, cooling, and networks; emerging technologies need security, investment, and clear policy.

We're bringing together the operators, technology leaders, investors, researchers, policymakers, and advisers working through those questions. We want people to leave with useful relationships, a clearer understanding of the challenges, and opportunities to move actual projects forward.

## Where leaders scaleinfrastructure, deploy capital, and secure global leadership.

## Cape Town

## Crypto Fest 2026

Welcome to a premier Web3 gathering in the stunning city of Cape Town, South Africa, where we'll explore blockchain and digital asset innovations with industry-leading speakers and provide valuable networking opportunities.

## Cape Town, South Africa | 8th Edition

Get ready for an unforgettable experience as Crypto Fest, hosted by Bitcoin Events, returns for its highly anticipated eighth edition, set against the breathtaking backdrop of Cape Town, South Africa!

As Cape Town's premier annual Web3 event, Crypto Fest brings together a diverse community of innovators, industry leaders, and blockchain enthusiasts to explore the rapidly evolving world of cryptocurrency, blockchain, and decentralized finance (DeFi).

This year's event features exclusive networking opportunities and sessions led by top industry experts, offering valuable insights into the latest trends shaping crypto, blockchain, Web3, and DeFi.

- Decentralised Intelligence: The Convergence of AI, Web3 & Data

Sub-Saharan Africa is the 3rd fastest-growing crypto region, per the 2025 report by Chainalysis.

From Jul 2024 to Jun 2025, it saw $205B in on-chain value, up 52% YoY. Nigeria led with $92.1B, nearly three times South Africa's. South Africa ranked second, helped by its clearer regulatory framework, while Ethiopia, Kenya, and Ghana rounded out the top five.

In 2024, South Africa took a major step by approving 248 Crypto Asset Service Provider (CASP) licences (as at December 2024). By December 2025, the FSCA had approved 300 CASPs out of 512 applications received (with 14 declined and 291 still active on the latest published list).

The Travel Rule for crypto asset transfers was implemented in South Africa via Financial Intelligence Centre Directive 9, effective 30 April 2025, aligning the country with international AML/CFT standards to combat financial crime.

As Africa continues to experience rapid growth in crypto adoption, Crypto Fest remains the premier platform to showcase regional and global trends, opportunities, and innovations shaping the future of Web3.

## WHAT TO EXPECT?

Get ready to be inspired by a stellar lineup of 30+ global innovators and thought leaders in the cryptocurrency, Metaverse, blockchain, Web3.0, and DeFi industry.

This is your chance to gain unparalleled insights into the future of decentralized technology and its transformative impact.

Get ready for something new this year - exhibitions are back at the event!

Explore a vibrant exhibition floor packed with leading crypto projects, blockchain innovators, licensed CASPs, fintech solutions, wallet providers, DeFi platforms, and institutional-grade tools.

Dive deep into crypto trends, emerging narratives, top trading tactics, and smart investment plays.

Stay ahead of the curve: uncover where the market is heading and explore the newest blockchain innovations and DeFi opportunities.

Get ready to connect with industry leaders, investors, developers, and innovators shaping the future of blockchain and cryptocurrency at Crypto Fest.

Through interactive sessions, panel discussions, and casual meetups, you'll have the opportunity to build valuable relationships and collaborate on innovative ideas.

## why you should attend

- Attend Cape Town's premier cryptocurrency and blockchain event.

- Explore Latest Trends - Dive into the latest developments in cryptocurrency, from stablecoins, compliance, and regulation to blockchain-based payments shaping the future of finance.

- Unlock the Power of DeFi - Discover boundless opportunities in Decentralized Finance (DeFi) and learn how it's revolutionizing financial empowerment worldwide.

- Stay Ahead of Regulation - Gain invaluable insights into the ever-evolving landscape of digital asset regulation and emerging policies that impact the industry.

- Connect with Africa's Web3 Community - Engage with leading innovators, builders, and investors driving blockchain adoption across the continent.

- Win Exclusive Crypto Swag - Stand a chance to grab crypto-branded socks, freebies, and exciting giveaways, making your experience even more memorable.

- Experience Cape Town's Beauty - Soak in the stunning scenery of one of the world's most breathtaking cities, enhancing your event experience.

- Network & Collaborate - Forge meaningful connections with industry experts, thought leaders, and fellow enthusiasts, sparking new ideas and collaborations that shape the future of Web3.

## who will attend

Prepare to engage with an extraordinary mix of professionals, visionaries, and trailblazers.

These include: industry innovators, global cryptocurrency and blockchain thought leaders, technology and innovation experts, technical decision makers, strategy influencers and analysts, entrepreneurs, FinTech professionals, payment specialists, forex and cryptocurrency traders, cryptocurrency mining entities, cryptocurrency exchanges, retail and institutional investors, software developers and engineers, system architects, technical leads, early adopters, venture capitalists, journalists and content writers, marketing specialists, accountants and auditors, attorneys, regulators, compliance officers, global policy makers, gamers, musicians, artists, key industry influencers and enthusiasts.

name: University Blockchain Conference 2026
description:
UBC: Where Talent Meets Opportunity

The University Blockchain Conference (UBC) - formerly the Midwest Blockchain Conference - is the leading access point connecting top university talent with the blockchain industry across the U.S. and beyond.

What started in the heartland of Ann Arbor has grown into a national movement and global network, now spanning 100+ universities including schools in South America and Europe. This year, we're evolving - new name, new home, same mission.

Built by students for students, UBC brings together university clubs, high schools, alumni, and industry leaders, all focused on pushing crypto forward through student leadership.

 Connecting Top Talent with Leading Companies

If you're a student or faculty member passionate about blockchain, this is your gateway. This November, connect with dozens of hiring companies, VCs eager to invest, and thought leaders excited to share knowledge with the next generation of builders.

If you're an industry professional, UBC offers unmatched exposure to over 1000+ ambitious students and dozens of elite university programs, many of which have traditionally been difficult to reach. Grow your user base, recruit standout talent, and shape the future of the space.

 Bigger Than Ever - Real Outcomes

UBC 2026 is set to surpass every prior year in every dimension: More speakers. More sponsors. More opportunities.

And it's working. Past attendees landed roles at:
Coinbase, Circle, Gemini, Galaxy, Polymarket, and many leading companies in blockchain, fintech, and policy.

This year, expect world-class speakers from industry and government, a major hackathon and research competition, tons of networking opportunities, massive side events, and as always, fire merch.

 Hosted at The University of Texas at Austin

Set in Austin, one of America's fastest-growing tech and innovation hubs, UT Austin is a national leader in engineering, finance, and entrepreneurship. Its leading blockchain club, Texas Blockchain, and its thriving blockchain community make it the perfect host for UBC 2026.

  Get Your Ticket

Early bird tickets are just $10 for students and $25 for industry. This small fee ensures attendees are committed and helps us better plan for an exceptional experience. UBC is a 501(c)(3) non-profit, student-run effort.

** IMPORTANT NOTE: If you are a student, make sure to apply for a travel subsidy here: https://forms.gle/GohTNo6bbxkGesXx7

Subsidy requests are approved by the team on a case-by-case basis. We aim to subsidize every student who travels to Austin for this event.

[Reserve your spot now]

 About the Organizers

College.xyz is a student-led 501(c)3 nonprofit connecting top university talent with the blockchain industry.

Beyond our flagship conference, we support students year-round through travel subsidies to events like Solana Breakpoint, sponsor hackathon tracks, and host side events at major conferences - all with the goal of onboarding more talent into the industry. We're building the next generation of blockchain leaders, on campus and beyond.

Interested in sponsoring, speaking, or volunteering?
